welcome:
🕵️ Welcome, Detective {name}!

A new case is waiting to be solved. Every day you'll receive one clue — investigate, think it through, and submit your answer. Solve all 5 days to complete the case and climb the leaderboard.
help_text:
🔍 How to play:
1. Each day a new clue is released.
2. You get 3 attempts to answer.
3. Faster, more accurate answers earn more points (100 / 75 / 50).
4. Solve all 5 clues to complete the case.
5. Top 3 detectives receive certificates.

Commands:
/play — see today's clue
/journal — your case notes
/profile — your stats
/leaderboard — top detectives
/myrank — your rank
/language — change language
about_text: Project Sherlock is an educational detective adventure. No cramming, no quiz stress — just curiosity, research, and one good clue a day.
